verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents its own Cloud Security monitoring of connected systems: AWS accounts, RDS, load balancers and IAM users; GitHub configuration, user access and Dependabot vulnerabilities; and Google Workspace users and Gmail settings. That covers ongoing checks against connected systems, but no evidence states how often these checks run, ties them to pass/fail control tests, or says failures surface within hours. The daily code scan is a separate code-security capability and does not substitute. Missing for 10: documented test cadence or near-real-time detection, explicit mapping of monitors to compliance controls with failing-control alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit

citations.quote: Oneleet currently monitors the following AWS resources: Accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, IAM users
This integration supports Cloud Security monitoring for GitHub. You can use it to monitor your GitHub configuration, user access, and Dependabot vulnerabilities.
Oneleet currently monitors the following on Google Workspace: User accounts, GMail settings
